card.line: Mount Moriah is the mountain in Jerusalem where Solomon built the LORD's house, and it is linked to the land where Abraham was to offer Isaac.

moments.title: God names the land of Moriah
moments.text: God tests Abraham and tells him to take his son Isaac to the land of Moriah. He is to offer Isaac there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains that God will show him.

moments.title: Solomon builds the temple
moments.text: Solomon begins to build the house of the LORD on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem. This is where the LORD had appeared to David, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
